simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַיָּלָה (H355) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.

simple.summary: אַיָּלָה (ʼayâlâh) means a doe or female deer First listed occurrence: 2Sam 22 34.

I. אֵלָה ; in name of a melody Psa 22:1 הַשַּׁחַר עַלאַֿיֶּלֶת compare De, & forhind as figurative of dawn Yom. 29 a.
